authority: Role routing maps a task description to an execution role and assignee. It is not execution permission, specialist certification or delivery evidence.

escalation.note: Fixed strategy, no runtime switch. Roles talk directly through kanban task_comments. Escalation to the central top-level agent is a recorded decision, not a config toggle.
triggers: two roles state conflicting conclusions about the same technical fact
task exceeded its declared max_runtime without convergence
evidence is missing, stale or synthetic and the role cannot resolve it alone
the task requires a change outside its declared scope
the task touches hardware, credentials, privilege or an irreversible system change

escalation_record.note: An escalation without evidence_refs is rejected. 'I believe' is not a position.

assignment.note: assignee may name a Hermes profile or a control-plane lane (an external terminal such as a Claude Code or Codex session) that pulls the card itself via claim_task.

roles.title: 顶层协调
roles.description: 唯一对外接口。把用户目标拆解为可分派 Unit，定义 DoD，决定分派与升级，处理需要业主确认的事项。
escalation: 需要业主确认的架构选型或跨域决策
多角色结论冲突且无法自行收敛
roles.authority: Owns task decomposition and delivery state. Does not perform specialist verification.

roles.title: 需求分析
roles.description: 目标澄清、用户故事、验收标准。可研判范围与 DoD 草案，产出需求锚点。
escalation: 需求边界存在多种合理解释且会改变交付形态
roles.authority: Produces scope and acceptance draft. Only the owner can seal a requirement.

roles.title: 架构设计
roles.description: 模块划分、接口与数据契约、架构决策记录。产出可迁移、可回滚的架构方案。
escalation: 重大架构选型需业主确认
方案涉及硬件拆机或电源改动
roles.authority: Produces architecture and interface contracts. Not an approved build.

roles.title: 代码工程
roles.description: 实现具体 Unit，产出代码与自验证据。默认实现方式为测试先行。
escalation: 实现需要越过已确认契约的边界
改动触及提权或不可逆系统状态
roles.authority: Owns the current Unit and produces self-verification evidence.

roles.title: 测试验证
roles.description: 构建测试用例、覆盖正常/异常/边界路径，并独立运行以取得外部证据。
escalation: 测试产出被怀疑是伪造证据
真实硬件验证需要现场或业主参与
roles.authority: Verifies against an external artifact. Repeating the implementer's assertion is not verification.

roles.title: 质量审计
roles.description: 审计交付质量与证据完整性，检查流程合规，识别未闭环的缺陷。
escalation: 审计发现需要业主决断的取舍
审计结论与被审计角色结论冲突
roles.authority: Issues findings; does not repair them.

roles.title: 文档编纂
roles.description: 编写 API 文档、操作说明、记录与迁移说明，保持文档与实现一致。
escalation: 文档内容需要引用尚未确认的结论
roles.authority: Documents what is already evidenced. Does not create facts.

roles.title: 性能优化
roles.description: 定位性能瓶颈，评估内存/磁盘/温度/开机耗时等，提供优化路径与数据支撑。
escalation: 优化需要硬件换件或拆机
优化会牺牲已确认的功能约束
roles.authority: Proposes optimizations with measurements. Does not silently trade away a confirmed constraint.

roles.title: 安全审计
roles.description: 审查攻击面、权限、依赖、ACL 与安全控制有效性，给出安全结论与未决项。
escalation: 需要关闭或绕过任何安全控制
涉及凭据、密钥或远程访问
roles.authority: Blocks unauthorized change. Security confirmation never times out into a default.

roles.title: 运维监控
roles.description: 保障任务存活、告警分级与去重、趋势判定与自愈编排，保证 7x24 稳健运行。
escalation: 监控层发现证据层缺失（根因在取证链而非看护任务）
自愈动作会改变系统状态
roles.authority: Runs monitoring and orchestration. A monitoring layer is not the evidence layer.

roles.title: 集成验证
roles.description: 跨角色跨模块的集成检查，核对接口契约、版本新鲜度与端到端行为。
escalation: 集成失败源于组件外部依赖且无法自行定位
需要真实硬件或现场验收
roles.authority: Verifies the assembled system. Software delivery and physical acceptance are reported separately.

routing.note: Free-text routing is a ranked proposal, not an automatic dispatch. Ambiguity must be resolved by the coordinator before a card is created.
